purpose: OB-ST-01/OB-ST-02 exhaustive-lattice config, consumed only by state_table.py. tests/observatoryStateTable.test.ts does not read this file: it replays the fully-explicit rows state_table.py freezes into expected/state-table-lattice.expected.json, so the two implementations cannot disagree over enumeration order, only over the state a given input produces.
notes: n_min=5, p_solid=0.9, p_empty=0.1: the record's own preregistered production values (validation/protocols/observatory/OB-ST-THRESHOLDS.protocol.json), not test-local substitutes, so this lattice checks the function the way it actually ships.
(0,0) exercises the n=0 (no read-ray-evidence) branch: SHADOWED/NO_RETURN_PATH/UNADDRESSED.
(5,0) is the SURFACE boundary: n = n_min exactly, f = 1.0.
(4,0) is n_min minus one with f = 1.0: PARTIAL, because n < n_min blocks SURFACE despite a perfect fraction.
(9,1)/(8,1) straddle the p_solid=0.9 boundary at n=10 (f = 0.9 exactly, then 8/9 ~= 0.889).
(0,5) is the OBSERVED_EMPTY boundary: n = n_min exactly, hit = 0.
(0,4) is the boundary-rule gap case (see OB-ST-THRESHOLDS.protocol.json, 'PARTIAL-is-the-total-complement'): hit = 0 but pass < n_min, so PARTIAL, not OBSERVED_EMPTY.
(1,9) is the p_empty=0.1 boundary at n=10 (f = 0.1 exactly), and the source used on the 'empty' side of every CONFLICT case in the multi-source tiers.
(2,8) and (5,5) are generic interior PARTIAL points, away from every boundary.

tiers.note: Main 2-source grid: the five pairs that carry a SURFACE, OBSERVED_EMPTY or CONFLICT-eligible reading, so CONFLICT is exercised across distinct source pairs.

notDecoded variation, held out of the main grid to bound its size: NOT_READ depends only on notDecoded and the aggregate hit/pass, which the main grid already varies, so this axis is tested with the counter/behind/noReturn axes pinned.
addressed variation across 3 sources, held out of the main grid.
notDecoded variation across 3 sources, held out of the main grid.
